summary: Tarlac 2nd District representative whose authored bills include progressive VAT reform, paid family care leave and free school supplies. Co-authored SOGIESC anti-discrimination, women's equal rights in the Family Code, anti-dynasty and wage-increase bills. Also authored family-conciliation and golden-anniversary marriage incentive bills.
caveat: Social score relies mainly on co-authored bills, which do not prove personal endorsement of every provision. Civil-liberties and institutions evidence was too thin.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored VAT reform exempting basic goods while taxing luxury items (-3), paid family care leave (-2) and free school supplies (-2); co-authored loan interest-rate cap and wage increases (-2). Senior-hiring incentives for private firms lean neutral.
